request.subject: UNIT:UNDEAD:RAIDER

layers.text: Change only the colours: the red hooded cloak becomes a ragged near-black charcoal cloak with a thin bright violet trim along its torn hem and a row of small pale warm ivory bone spikes along the hood's ridge; his skin becomes pallid light warm ash grey with no blue at all; his eyes glow bright violet and every small blue flame becomes bright violet; the claws stay pale ivory. Keep the face, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
